matches.description: Compute a deterministic basis for the right nullspace of a bounded integer matrix over GF(p). The prime is supplied explicitly so that the field characteristic is always unambiguous.
matches.title: Compute nullspace basis over GF(p)

matches.description: Compute the exact rank of a bounded integer matrix over the prime field GF(p). The prime is supplied explicitly so that characteristic-dependent rank is always unambiguous.
matches.title: Compute matrix rank over GF(p)

matches.description: Compute the RREF fundamental basis of the right nullspace over QQ. When columns are ordered vectors, the result gives their rank and every exact rational linear dependency coefficient.
matches.title: Compute a canonical exact nullspace or relation basis

matches.description: Compute the reduced row-echelon form of a bounded integer matrix over GF(p), with pivot columns and rank. The prime is supplied explicitly so that the field characteristic is always unambiguous.
matches.title: Compute RREF over GF(p)

matches.description: Compute the determinant of a square matrix whose entries are rational functions in declared algebraically independent variables, using SymPy's exact fraction-free Bareiss algorithm.
matches.title: Compute an exact symbolic matrix determinant (det) over QQ(t_1, ..., t_n)
